public_rationale: The checkable figure in this claim is that OpenAI and Anthropic 'now make up 50%' of upcoming hyperscaler revenue. Reuters, citing The Information on May 5, 2026, reported that contracts with the two now make up more than half of the roughly $2 trillion backlog at major cloud providers. A later Jefferies estimate also put it at about half. So the 50% figure holds as of the post. The claim that neither company has a path to profitability 'outside of accounting shenanigans and willing co-conspirators' has exceptions no evidence can test, and 'the only way they can pay' is about future funding. Neither is scored. Anthropic's GAAP operating profit of $974m in Q2 2026 cuts against the profitability remark and is listed as counterevidence.
limitations: The share is an estimate from the press and analysts, not a hyperscaler disclosure.
The profitability and funding parts of the sentence are not scored.

statement.excerpt: Anthropic and OpenAI — neither of whom have any path to sustainability or profitability outside of accounting shenanigans and willing co-conspirators — now make up 50% of all upcoming hyperscaler revenues, and the only way either of them can pay is if somebody, either a venture capitalist or hyperscaler, chooses to give them the money.

from_speaker: now make up 50% of all upcoming hyperscaler revenues

neither of whom have any path to sustainability or profitability outside of accounting shenanigans and willing co-conspirators
our_interpretation: 'Upcoming hyperscaler revenues' is read as the contracted revenue backlog (remaining performance obligations) of the major cloud providers.
'Now' is the state as of the post (May 26, 2026). The latest backlog disclosures came with Q1 results in late April, and press analysis of them followed in May. Pre-publication May figures count.
'50%' is read as roughly half; 'more than half' meets it.

'No path to profitability outside of accounting shenanigans and willing co-conspirators' builds in exceptions that cannot be tested, since any profit or funder can be labeled one of them. It is a judgment about prospects and is not scored as decisive. 'The only way either can pay' is about how future commitments will be funded and is treated as context.
criteria.support_condition: Reliable reporting from around the post date shows OpenAI and Anthropic together account for about half or more of major hyperscalers' contracted backlog.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable reporting from around the post date shows their combined share is well below half (for example, under 40%).
